description: Surface Optimization of the (111) Surface of Cu (Cubic, Fm-3m) and Surface Energy Calculation
user_prompt: Optimize the (111) surface of copper Cu (cubic, Fm-3m) and calculate the surface energy. Report the final surface energy in J/m^2.

references: Patra, Bates, Sun & Perdew, Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. 114, E9188 (2017)
method.modeling: fcc Cu (Fm-3m), nonmagnetic, close-packed (111) surface; symmetric slab (>= 5-7 layers, converged), vacuum >= 15 A, surface relaxed.
method.rationale: Value 1.33 J/m^2 is the PBE Cu(111) surface energy from Patra et al. 2017 (VASP, PAW-PBE; the same surface gives LDA 1.81, PBEsol 1.59, SCAN 1.49). PBE underestimates the experimental ~1.79 J/m^2 (Tyson & Miller 1977), so the case is graded against the PBE value, not experiment. Cu(111) is the close-packed, nonmagnetic fcc facet. Tolerance +/-0.20 J/m^2 (absolute) covers PBE inter-setup scatter (slab thickness, k-mesh, pseudopotential); larger deviations usually signal an unconverged slab.
